name: Vegan Banana Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup plant-based milk (such as almond or soy milk)
Maple syrup or agave nectar (optional, for sweetness)
instructions: In a saucepan, mash the ripe banana with a fork until smooth.
Add the rolled oats, plant-based milk, and cinnamon to the saucepan. Stir well to combine.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes or until the oats are cooked and the mixture has thickened to your desired consistency.
If desired, drizzle with maple syrup or agave nectar for sweetness before serving. Enjoy your delicious and easy vegan banana oatmeal breakfast!
